A few steps only.

- Full definitions: [Glossary](glossary.qmd)
- Citeable status: [Official status](tracker.qmd)

## Orient first

Follow the **Orient** menu in this order:

1. [Course overview](overview.qmd) — week map and what the course covers  
2. [What is LAE?](primer.qmd) — plain-English scope  
3. [How does LAE work?](business-overview.qmd) — value, who pays whom, sectors  
4. [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd) — who regulates what  
5. This page — how the rest of the site fits  
6. [Common questions](faq.qmd) — ten short Q&As  
7. [Key figures](key-figures.qmd) — short sourced numbers  

Handy Glossary links when a term appears:

- [Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) (keep separate from the earlier Regulatory Sandbox)
- [Cap. 448G](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law)
- [CASK](glossary.qmd#business-and-economics) (cost per available seat-kilometre)

## Then Teach

- **Teach** menu — one page per week (notes, slides PDF, summary, readings). Start with [Week 1](week-01.qmd).  
- Slide PDFs are the class outline. The week page holds the fuller notes and readings.
- [Formulas](formulas.qmd) — named teaching identities from the week notes (cheat sheet).
- **Self-check** — short multiple-choice questions at the end of a week page (private practice; nothing is stored). Start with [Week 1 · Self-check](week-01.qmd#self-check).

## Official facts

- [Glossary](glossary.qmd) — terms and diagrams  
- [Official status](tracker.qmd) — [OPEN]{.status-chip .status-open} / [WATCH]{.status-chip .status-watch} / [settled]{.status-chip .status-settled} labels  
- [Companies & sectors](landscape.qmd) — who is in the market  

## Updates

- [Government news](news.qmd) — dated government and regulatory items  
- [Business news](industry.qmd) — dated company and industry items  
- [Use cases](usecases.qmd) — trial and operating applications  
- [Timeline](dates.qmd) — dated instruments and milestones  

This site has no Blackboard admin. Course logistics stay on the teaching platform.
